mug_yuki: Assumed it stayed at desk_b1 or moved to kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (09:00) but back at desk_b1 (10:41, 13:38). It moves with Yuki’s immediate location: kitchen for meals, desk for work. Check desk_b1 during work hours, kitchen_table_k1 during meal times.

water_bottle_yuki: Assumed it was at kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at desk_b1 (10:22, 14:35) and dish_rack_k1 (21:03). Yuki keeps it at the desk while working and washes it in the evening. Check desk_b1 during the day, dish_rack_k1 late at night.

tablet_yuki: Assumed it stayed at desk_b1 or moved to kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at nightstand_b1 (16:47). Yuki likely moves it to the bedroom for breaks or evening use. Check nightstand_b1 in the late afternoon/evening, desk_b1 during core work hours.

glass_yuki: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b1. Actually found at sink_k1 (21:01) and cupboard_k1 (22:59). Yuki washes it in the evening and stores it in the kitchen cupboard. Check sink_k1 or cupboard_k1 late at night, not the bedroom.

glass_nora: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b2 or moved to kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (20:41) and then cupboard_k1 (21:13). Nora puts it away in the cupboard after use. Check kitchen_table_k1 in the evening, cupboard_k1 late at night.

water_bottle_nora: Assumed it was at couch_l1 or kitchen_table_k1. Actually found at kitchen_table_k1 (20:43) and then dish_rack_k1 (21:13). Nora washes it and puts it in the dish rack. Check kitchen_table_k1 in the evening, dish_rack_k1 late at night.

book_nora: Assumed it stayed at nightstand_b2. Actually found at armchair_l1 (21:38). Nora reads in the living room. Check armchair_l1 or couch_l1 in the evening.
